📍 Ruta ng QCPD libreng Sakay:
• EDSA – East Avenue hanggang Litex sa Commonwealth (vice versa)
• EDSA – QC City Hall hanggang Commonwealth-Litex (vice versa)

Patuloy ang pag-agapay ng iba-ibang ahensya ng gobyerno sa mga pasahero ngayong may transport strike.

Nananatili namang naka-monitor ang mga tauhan ng QC Traffic and Transport Management Department, QCPD, at MMDA upang matiyak ang kaligtasan ng mga motorista at pasahero.

Nakaantabay ang mga tauhan ng QC Police District (QCPD) para gabayan ang mga motorista at pasahero na posibleng maapektuhan ng tigil-pasada.

Sinisiguro nila ang maayos na daloy ng trapiko sa mga apektadong lugar kasabay ng transport strike at peace rally sa Philcoa.

May mga nakaantabay na QCity Bus at QC e-trikes sa harap ng National Housing Authority, na nagsisilbing command post ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) at Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS).

Handa itong magsilbing service papasok at pauwi hanggang mamayang 8:00 PM.

Narito ang kumpleto at updated na listahan ng bawat ruta at schedule ng ating QCity Bus: https://t.co/gOuQuqTEqK

OSEN | #Dex wakes up in a mangrove swamp and questions reality, “Feels like a dream” #KimHyeYoon also mentally breaks down (#FreshOffTheSea in Calape)

tvN’s #FOTS spin off in Calape has revealed what goes on inside a mangrove wetland.

The show captures everyday life by the sea along with seasonal dishes you can only find there. It gained attention for its warm, family like chemistry.

In this spin off set in Calape, Philippines, #YumJungah, #ParkJoonmyeon, #Dex and #KimHyeyoon come together, raising expectations for a new kind of chemistry in an exotic setting. 

The 1st teaser released on the 19th opens deep inside a mangrove wetland in the Philippines. The cast, covered head to toe in mud, look completely drained.

An exhausted Yum Jungah responds “No” when a local asks, “Are you okay?”, showing just how extreme the situation is. Dex reacts in disbelief, saying, “I was in Korea until yesterday… this feels like a dream,” as if he can’t process what’s happening.

Park Joonmyeon & Kim Hyeyoon’s overwhelmed expressions (basically mental breakdown mode) add to the curiosity. Toward the end, the cast shout, “This isn’t it!” and “Don’t ever come back here again,” making viewers wonder what led them into the mangrove swamp and what kind of intense labor they faced.

Even with just a 15 second teaser, the show builds anticipation with plenty of fun moments. Alongside Yum Jungah and Park JoonMyeon strong presence, attention is also on the new “youngest line” chemistry between Dex & Kim Hyeyoon.

FOTS spin off in Calape premieres on April 16 (Thu) at 8:40 PM.
